title: The new iPad Pro is almost as fast as one of Apple's $2,800 laptops — but it only costs $800 (AAPL, INTC)
text: The new iPad Pro is almost as fast as one of Apple's $2,800 laptops — but it only costs $800 (AAPL, INTC) Thursday, 1 November 2018 () · The first Geekbench processor speed test score is out for Apple's new iPad Pro . · Its score is very close to what a 15-inch MacBook Pro with an Intel Core i7 chip gets. · Although benchmark tests aren't perfect, the scores still underscore how powerful Apple's chips have gotten. · Apple's new iPad Pro costs $799 and will ...
